{{Top|leg}}
'''Multitrack recording units''' were used around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to create and playback two-dimensional copies of audio and visual components of any given situation. This device was placed inside an [[inert-screen load shifter]] by the [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]] to secretly record the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|aunt]] and [[Owen Lars/Legends|uncle]] were murdered.
